messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: P1 - GreenBriar VPC canary errors observed (error rate > 12% for 2m). Affected pool: gb-vpc-canary-1. Page: Anna (on-call)
Anna (on-call): seeing increased 5xx to GreenBriar during canary traffic. Loading the logs now. assigning @Samir P to runtime check.
Samir P: on it. early look shows repeated OOMs in the dedicated runtime tasks - liveness restarts. grabbing pod logs and artifact id.
Anna (on-call): Priya from GreenBriar pinged our support channel, they report slow responses and partial failures for some tenants. Priya: can you post error ids?
Priya (GreenBriar): latency spikes ~200-400ms then a few 502s. Their app retries and some user requests failed. They are on the canary slice (10%). They asked for rollback if it’s unsafe.
Samir P: logs (abridged):
```
2026-04-02T02:14:33Z runtime[worker-7]: WARN KVCache miss spike: 98%
2026-04-02T02:14:35Z runtime[worker-7]: ERROR allocation failed: cannot allocate pages: out of memory
2026-04-02T02:14:35Z runtime[worker-7]: INFO restarting worker
```
Samir P: stack looks like new runtime build (v1.7.3-rc2) interacting badly with a heavy prefix cache on the GreenBriar workload. suspect memory leak under their sequence distribution.
John (Prod Eng): rollback plan ready: pin to previous artifact art-2026-03-29-stable (runtime v1.7.1) for GreenBriar tenant in VPC; isolate canary pool during pinback; divert new traffic to reserved fallback pool. Need 2 approvals to proceed.
Anna (on-call): steps I propose: 1) Pause canary ramp (set rollout 0%) 2) Pin tenant to art-2026-03-29-stable 3) Drain affected runtime instances 4) Monitor for errors 5) Gradual resumption after verification.
Samir P: commands I will run (executing now):
```
# pause canary ramp for GreenBriar
rdwctl rollout set --scope tenant:greenbriar --percent 0 --env vpc
# pin artifact
rdwctl tenant pin --tenant greenbriar --artifact art-2026-03-29-stable --force --note "emergency-pin-ooms"
```
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: tenant-pin-job-8721. Started by Samir P.
Anna (on-call): @Priya we'll do the pin now; this will route GreenBriar traffic off the canary variant. Expect a short reconnection window. We'll keep you updated every 2m. :white_check_mark:
Priya (GreenBriar): thanks, please keep me posted. We can hold traffic if needed.
Leanne (on-call-2): I'm taking handoff in 10m. if you need escalation to infra, ping me. I'll be online for the verification step.
Samir P: pin completed and artifact pinned to art-2026-03-29-stable. Command output:
```
> rdwctl tenant pin --tenant greenbriar --artifact art-2026-03-29-stable --force
Success: tenant greenbriar pinned to art-2026-03-29-stable
Affected hosts: gb-vpc-canary-1a, gb-vpc-canary-1b
```
Samir P: initiating drain of affected instances:
```
rdwctl instance drain --pool gb-vpc-canary-1 --grace 60s
```
deploy-bot: Drain started for gb-vpc-canary-1. Active connections will be moved to fallback-pool-03.
Anna (on-call): monitoring metrics: request error rate falling from 12% -> 3% within 45s of drain. latency back to baseline for most endpoints.
Priya (GreenBriar): confirming reduced errors on our side, thanks. A couple of long-running jobs still show retries but overall okay.
Samir P: captured metrics snapshot and heap profiles forwarded to /opt/incident/artifacts/2681234567/ for the infra/research team. Suspect RC build alloc path to cache.
John (Prod Eng): marking this as a pinback mitigation (not a permanent rollback). Next actions: run post-mortem, regression test the RC build with GreenBriar workload in a dedicated sandbox, add memory throttling guard for runtime experiments.
Leanne (on-call-2): taking over active watch. Anna handing off: any pending actions?
Anna (on-call): handing off live watch to @Leanne (reports every 5m). I will document timeline in the incident tracker and notify ops review. Great job team.
Leanne (on-call-2): acknowledged. I'll keep monitoring the pinned tenant and confirm with Priya before we re-enable canary ramp. If error rate stays <1% for 10m we can consider incremental ramp to 5%.
Priya (GreenBriar): appreciate the fast response. Please share post-mortem and any mitigations we need to apply on our side.
Samir P: quick note for postmortem: reproduce steps, heap growth trace with RC, and suggestion to limit prefix cache size for v1.7.3-rc builds.
IncidentBot: Incident update: P1 -> mitigated (pinback). The incident will remain open for post-mortem until 2026-04-03T06:00:00Z or until owners close it.
Leanne (on-call-2): closing update: metrics stable, no new 5xx for 12m, handing back to release squad to validate RC. I'll notify when we re-try.
Anna (on-call): thanks all. I'll follow-up with the post-mortem draft and link to artifacts. :memo:
